listings.remarks: Looking for a new home? This beautiful residence with a POOL in the desirable Palm Valley is the one! Offering 3 beds + den, 2 baths, mature landscape, and a 2.5-car garage w/cabinetry. Discover inviting living spaces, perfect for everyday living & entertaining! The eat-in kitchen boasts built-in appliances w/gas range, a pantry, ample cabinetry, and an island w/breakfast bar. The versatile den is perfect for an office! The large primary bedroom has a walk-in closet and an ensuite with dual sinks & separate tub/shower. When it's time to unwind, the backyard oasis awaits you with a covered patio, lush lawn, and a refreshing pool for year-round enjoyment. Don't miss this opportunity!

features.Kitchen: Kitchen island with breakfast bar, pantry, gas range, built-in microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator
features.Primary suite: Walk-in closet, dual sinks, separate tub and shower

schools: Agua Fria Union High School District

listings.remarks: Looking for a new home? This beautiful two-story residence in Esclante is the one! Providing 3 beds, 2 baths + powder room, and a 2-car garage. The interior features dual-pane windows, 9ft ceilings, and carpet & tile flooring in all the right places. Enjoy the seamlessly flowing open-concept floor plan, perfect for everyday living & entertaining! The impressive kitchen boasts built-in appliances, granite counters, a walk-in pantry, and an island w/breakfast bar. All bedrooms are upstairs, along with a cozy loft! The primary bedroom has an ensuite with dual sinks & a walk-in closet. Out back, you have a covered patio to relax or enjoy a BBQ. Close proximity to the community pool, picnic area, tot lots, basketball, and pickleball courts. Don't miss this opportunity!

features.Kitchen: Kitchen island with breakfast bar, walk-in pantry, granite counters, electric oven and cooktop, built-in microwave, dishwasher, disposal
features.Interior: 9 ft+ ceilings, loft, upstairs laundry (washer and dryer included)
features.Cooling & heating: Central air, ceiling fans, electric heat
